title: justicia lythroides
intro: Justicia lythroides, commonly known as the 'Thai Pride', is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Justicia lythroides include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
